title: Llamafile Builder Configuration Schema
description: Schema for config.json - defines the UI configuration items and their mapping to llamafile CLI flags

ConfigSchemaItem.description: A configuration item that can be a section, text input, dropdown, boolean toggle, or slider

Section.description: A collapsible section containing nested configuration items. Can be toggleable if 'key' is specified.

label.description: Display label for the section header

key.description: If present, makes the section toggleable. The key is used to store the enabled/disabled state in configValues.

description.description: Help text explaining what this section controls

default.description: Default toggle state when 'key' is present. Defaults to true if not specified.

flag.description: CLI flag to emit when the section is enabled (e.g., '--server'). Only emitted if section has a 'key' and is enabled.

items.description: Nested configuration items within this section

Text.description: A text or number input field

key.description: Unique identifier used to store/retrieve the value in configValues

label.description: Display label for the input field

description.description: Help text explaining what this setting controls

default.description: Default value. Can be a string or number depending on value_type.

value_type.description: The data type of the value

flag.description: CLI flag to use when generating .args file (e.g., '--host', '-m'). If not specified, this item doesn't generate output.

hidden.description: If true, this item is not shown in the UI but still included in .args generation

required.description: If true, this field must have a value

conditional.description: Condition that must be met for this item to be included. 'has_mmproj' means only include if model has a vision adapter.

Dropdown.description: A dropdown/select field with predefined options

key.description: Unique identifier used to store/retrieve the value in configValues

description.description: Help text explaining what this setting controls

default.description: Default selected value. Should match one of the options.

options.description: Available options for the dropdown. Can be strings or numbers.

flag.description: CLI flag to use when generating .args file (e.g., '--ctx-size')

hidden.description: If true, this item is not shown in the UI

required.description: If true, this field must have a value

conditional.description: Condition that must be met for this item to be included

key.description: Unique identifier used to store/retrieve the value in configValues

description.description: Help text explaining what this setting controls

flag.description: CLI flag to emit when enabled (e.g., '--webui', '--no-mmap'). Only emitted if value is true.

hidden.description: If true, this item is not shown in the UI

required.description: If true, this field must be enabled

conditional.description: Condition that must be met for this item to be included

Slider.description: A slider for selecting a numeric value within a range

key.description: Unique identifier used to store/retrieve the value in configValues

description.description: Help text explaining what this setting controls

default.description: Default value. Must be between min and max.

step.description: Increment step for the slider. Defaults to 1.

flag.description: CLI flag to use when generating .args file

hidden.description: If true, this item is not shown in the UI

required.description: If true, this field must have a value

conditional.description: Condition that must be met for this item to be included
